reuse.why: Adds a shared isHoliday used by isNonWorkingDay and by both daily-skip sites in server/schedules/app.ts, though those sites keep composing d.isWeekend || isHoliday instead of using an exported isNonWorkingDay.

duplication.why: Holiday matching is defined once; the pre-existing weekend-or-holiday composition remains duplicated at two server sites.

placement.why: The matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other date-resolution helpers.

scope.why: Only the helper, its call sites and one test are touched.

maintainability.why: One small definition of what an entry matches; minor nits are the unsorted import and the leftover parallel weekend composition.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks now go through isHoliday; the inline d.isWeekend compositions in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange were pre-existing.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic introduced; the match was centralised.
